Class GameNotifier

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.gamemanager.GameNotifier
public class GameNotifier extends Object
Broadcasts game events to all registered ModelObserver instances.

Each method converts model objects to their DTO counterparts where needed and forwards the notification to every observer in the listener list. Some methods apply per-observer filtering, sending the notification only to the current player.

    • notifyDrawable

      void notifyDrawable(ActionsDTO dto, String currPlayer)
      Notifies observers of the draw actions currently available.

      The current player receives the real ActionsDTO; all other observers receive an empty actions DTO to signal that no actions are available to them.

      Parameters:
      dto - the draw actions available to the current player
      currPlayer - nickname of the player who may take a draw action
